items.stem: 36‑yo with hives, tongue swelling, wheeze; BP 82/50; SpO₂ 89% RA.
items.question: Which immediate action is BEST?
items.rationale: IM epinephrine first; others are adjuncts.

items.stem: 79‑yo with RLL infiltrate, lactate 5.2 after 2 L; BP 84/40.
items.question: Stage + next two priorities:
options: Septic shock; start norepinephrine while obtaining two blood cultures and giving broad‑spectrum antibiotics
Septic shock; delay antibiotics for procalcitonin
items.rationale: Persistent hypotension + high lactate after fluids = septic shock; NE + cultures + broad abx.
